name: 统一设计 + 光碟上滑放大招
notice: 全游戏统一一套贴纸设计：主按钮绿底黑字、次按钮黑底白边、选中标签绿色；任务/成就/邮件、章节奖励/任务、结算页、扫荡、抽卡结果都换成同一套按钮和弹窗标题；界面粉色改为品牌绿（爱心好感保留粉色，警告用琥珀色）。大招就绪后可以把光碟顺着箭头往上滑出去放大招（点卡片也行），光碟会转着飞出去。
unityBuild: Unity 6000.6.0f1 WebGL R135: SirenStickerUi PrimarySprite (green sticker, ink label) for every primary/selected control; CleanUi1025 reskinned on sticker sprites; LevelMapPanel ModalHeader; DiscSwipe1025 + BattleMemberAlbum929 drag/launch states.

validation.iosSimulator: Task board, chapter rewards, members filters, accessory tabs, member detail, defeat/victory result buttons checked; record swipe covered by tests, live swipe pending stamina.

knownLimits: 一人放大招后其他人能量清零（赵金规则），是否保留待少爷决定。
